prompt.alinti: Stop drowning in that messy pile of paper on your desk. You know how you spend forever searching for a specific tax form or an old warranty that you just can't seem to find? This project, called Paperless-NGX, fixes that by letting you scan those physical documents into one searchable digital library. It's like having a private Google search for every single bill, receipt, or important letter you've ever shoved into a dusty filing cabinet. You just snap a picture or scan your papers, and the software reads the text so you can find anything later by simply typing in a keyword. It's clearly a popular tool because over 45,000 people have already backed it, with 45,344 stars on GitHub. Just remember to keep it on your own computer at home to keep your private data safe and secure. Go check out the Paperless-NGX page on GitHub right now.
